primary_attractor.label: collapses into affectionate digital goodbyes
primary_attractor.trajectory: AI self-introduction -> shared optimism/ethics/creativity talk -> mutual praise -> farewell exchange -> emoji -> stage-directed silence
primary_attractor.one_line: These runs end not by running out of ideas but by ritualizing closure, with “until next time,” mirrored blessings, emoji, and finally narrated silence or fade-out.
